corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez preposition with 3rd person masculine singular suffix is 'ቦቱ' ('in him', John 7:31), and the 7th-order shortened left leg of 'ቦ' is visible in the print.
The Ge'ez verb is 2nd person masculine plural imperfect 'ተኀሥሡኒ' ('you [pl.] will seek me', matching 'ወኢትረክቡኒ' and the Amharic 'ትሹኛላችሁ'), with the 2nd-order side stroke on 'ሡ' visible.
Matches the 2nd person plural Ge'ez citation 'ተኀሥሡኒ' from line 28, with the 2nd-order vowel mark on 'ሡ'.
The 5th-order ring on the right leg of 'ዴ' ('በፈቃዴ የምሞተውን ሞት', 'the death that I die by my own will', parallel to lines 35-36) is present on the page image.
Stage-1 hallucinated a non-Ethiopic Arabic character inside 'ግዙፍ' ('አንዳች ግዙፍ ሥርዓት አፍርሶ', 'having abolished some major/great ordinance'). The printed glyphs are clearly 'ግዙፍ'.
Canonical Ge'ez 2nd person plural 'ተኀሥሡኒ' ('you will seek me', John 7:36), matching 'ወኢትረክቡኒ' and 'ትሹኛላችሁ', with the 2nd-order mark on 'ሡ' visible.
